names.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition
names.ko: 엔비디아 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 워크스테이션 에디션

description.en: Professional desktop workstation graphics card in NVIDIA's RTX PRO Blackwell line, with 96 GB of GDDR7 ECC memory and a 600 W board power rating.
description.ko: 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 라인의 워크스테이션용 데스크톱 그래픽카드로, 96GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리와 600W 보드 전력 사양을 갖췄습니다.

facts.note: Announced 2025-03-18; the announcement says availability through global distribution partners starts in April 2025 (systems from manufacturers from May).

names.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
names.ko: 엔비디아 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q 워크스테이션 에디션

description.en: Lower-power variant of NVIDIA's RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation card, keeping 96 GB of GDDR7 ECC memory with a 300 W board power rating.
description.ko: 엔비디아 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 워크스테이션 카드의 저전력 버전으로, 96GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리를 유지하면서 보드 전력은 300W입니다.

facts.note: Announced 2025-03-18; the announcement says availability through global distribution partners starts in April 2025 (systems from manufacturers from May).

names.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell Workstation Edition
names.ko: 엔비디아 RTX PRO 5500 Blackwell 워크스테이션 에디션

description.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell workstation card with 84 GB of GDDR7 ECC memory, intended for rack-mounted workstation deployment; NVIDIA lists it as coming soon with preliminary specifications.
description.ko: 84GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리를 탑재한 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 워크스테이션 카드로, 랙 장착형 워크스테이션 배치를 위한 제품입니다. 엔비디아는 출시 예정 제품으로 표기하고 사양을 잠정치로 안내합니다.

facts.note: NVIDIA 'Max Power Consumption: Up to 600 W'; preliminary specification

description.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell workstation card in its 48 GB GDDR7 ECC memory configuration; NVIDIA's datasheet lists it alongside the 72 GB model with the same core count and memory bandwidth.
description.ko: 48GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리 구성의 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 워크스테이션 카드로, 엔비디아 데이터시트에서 코어 수와 메모리 대역폭이 같은 72GB 모델과 함께 표기됩니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2025-03-18). The press release says availability in summer 2025 from BOXX, Dell, HP and Lenovo and through distribution partners, without a specific date.

description.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell workstation card in its 72 GB GDDR7 ECC memory configuration; NVIDIA's datasheet lists it alongside the 48 GB model with the same core count and memory bandwidth.
description.ko: 72GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리 구성의 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 워크스테이션 카드로, 엔비디아 데이터시트에서 코어 수와 메모리 대역폭이 같은 48GB 모델과 함께 표기됩니다.

facts.note: NVIDIA blog of 2025-12-18 says the 72GB model is now generally available from partners; broader availability through system builders from early 2026.

names.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Workstation Edition
names.ko: 엔비디아 RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell 워크스테이션 에디션

description.en: Dual-slot NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell workstation card with 32 GB of GDDR7 ECC memory on a 256-bit bus and a 200 W board power rating.
description.ko: 256비트 버스의 32GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리와 200W 보드 전력 사양을 갖춘 듀얼 슬롯 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2025-03-18). The press release says availability in summer 2025 from BOXX, Dell, HP and Lenovo and through distribution partners, without a specific date.

description.en: Single-slot NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell workstation card with 24 GB of GDDR7 ECC memory on a 192-bit bus and a 145 W board power rating.
description.ko: 192비트 버스의 24GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리와 145W 보드 전력 사양을 갖춘 싱글 슬롯 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2025-03-18). The press release says availability in summer 2025 from BOXX, Dell, HP and Lenovo and through distribution partners, without a specific date.

names.en: NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF Edition
names.ko: 엔비디아 RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF 에디션

description.en: Half-height, dual-slot small-form-factor NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell card with 24 GB of GDDR7 ECC memory and a 70 W board power rating.
description.ko: 하프 하이트 듀얼 슬롯 소형 폼팩터 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 카드로, 24GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리와 70W 보드 전력 사양을 갖췄습니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2025-08-11). The post says the card is coming later in 2025 without a specific availability date.
Datasheet footnote: uses full-length PCIe interface

description.en: Compact dual-slot NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell workstation card with 16 GB of GDDR7 ECC memory on a 128-bit bus and 70 W maximum power consumption.
description.ko: 128비트 버스의 16GB GDDR7 ECC 메모리와 최대 70W 소비 전력을 갖춘 소형 듀얼 슬롯 엔비디아 RTX PRO Blackwell 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2025-08-11). The post says the card is coming later in 2025 without a specific availability date.
Datasheet footnote: uses full-length PCIe interface

description.en: NVIDIA professional workstation card built on the Ada Lovelace architecture, with 48 GB of GDDR6 ECC memory on a 384-bit bus and a 300 W board power rating.
description.ko: 에이다 러브레이스 아키텍처 기반의 엔비디아 전문가용 워크스테이션 카드로, 384비트 버스의 48GB GDDR6 ECC 메모리와 300W 보드 전력 사양을 갖췄습니다.

facts.note: Announced 2022-09-20; the press release says availability from distribution partners and manufacturers starting in December 2022.

description.en: NVIDIA Ada Lovelace workstation card with 32 GB of GDDR6 ECC memory on a 256-bit bus and a 250 W board power rating.
description.ko: 256비트 버스의 32GB GDDR6 ECC 메모리와 250W 보드 전력 사양을 갖춘 엔비디아 에이다 러브레이스 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: Press release of 2023-08-08 says the RTX 5000 is available and shipping starting that day.

description.en: NVIDIA Ada Lovelace workstation card with 24 GB of GDDR6 ECC memory on a 192-bit bus and a 210 W board power rating.
description.ko: 192비트 버스의 24GB GDDR6 ECC 메모리와 210W 보드 전력 사양을 갖춘 엔비디아 에이다 러브레이스 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2023-08-08). The press release says the RTX 4500 and RTX 4000 will be available in fall 2023, without a specific date.

description.en: Single-slot NVIDIA Ada Lovelace workstation card with 20 GB of GDDR6 ECC memory on a 160-bit bus and a 130 W board power rating.
description.ko: 160비트 버스의 20GB GDDR6 ECC 메모리와 130W 보드 전력 사양을 갖춘 싱글 슬롯 엔비디아 에이다 러브레이스 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2023-08-08). The press release says the RTX 4500 and RTX 4000 will be available in fall 2023, without a specific date.

description.en: Half-height small-form-factor NVIDIA Ada Lovelace workstation card with 20 GB of GDDR6 ECC memory and a 70 W board power rating.
description.ko: 20GB GDDR6 ECC 메모리와 70W 보드 전력 사양을 갖춘 하프 하이트 소형 폼팩터 엔비디아 에이다 러브레이스 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: Announced 2023-03-21; the press release says availability from distribution partners starting in April 2023.
Stated in the press release as an 'estimated price of $1,250'

description.en: Compact NVIDIA Ada Lovelace workstation card with 16 GB of GDDR6 ECC memory and 70 W maximum power consumption.
description.ko: 16GB GDDR6 ECC 메모리와 최대 70W 소비 전력을 갖춘 소형 엔비디아 에이다 러브레이스 워크스테이션 카드입니다.

facts.note: NVIDIA blog of 2024-02-12 says the card is available now through distribution partners (from Dell, HP and Lenovo from April 2024).

description.en: AMD workstation graphics card in the Radeon PRO W7000 series, built on RDNA 3 with 48 GB of GDDR6 memory on a 384-bit bus.
description.ko: RDNA 3 기반의 AMD 라데온 PRO W7000 시리즈 워크스테이션 그래픽카드로, 384비트 버스의 48GB GDDR6 메모리를 탑재했습니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2023-04-13). The press release expected availability from e-tailers/retailers starting in Q2 2023.
AMD 'SEP' (suggested e-tail price) in the launch press release

names.en: AMD Radeon PRO W7900 Dual Slot
names.ko: AMD 라데온 PRO W7900 듀얼 슬롯

description.en: Dual-slot version of AMD's Radeon PRO W7900 workstation card, listed by AMD with the same RDNA 3 GPU configuration and 48 GB of GDDR6 memory.
description.ko: AMD 라데온 PRO W7900 워크스테이션 카드의 듀얼 슬롯 버전으로, AMD는 동일한 RDNA 3 GPU 구성과 48GB GDDR6 메모리로 표기합니다.

description.en: AMD Radeon PRO W7000 series workstation card built on RDNA 3, in its original 32 GB GDDR6 configuration on a 256-bit bus.
description.ko: RDNA 3 기반의 AMD 라데온 PRO W7000 시리즈 워크스테이션 카드로, 256비트 버스의 32GB GDDR6 메모리를 탑재한 기본 구성입니다.

facts.note: Year of availability as stated by the source (announced 2023-04-13). The press release expected availability from e-tailers/retailers starting in Q2 2023.
AMD 'SEP' (suggested e-tail price) in the launch press release

description.en: 48 GB version of AMD's Radeon PRO W7800 workstation card, with a 384-bit GDDR6 memory bus and the same 70-compute-unit RDNA 3 GPU as the 32 GB model.
description.ko: AMD 라데온 PRO W7800 워크스테이션 카드의 48GB 버전으로, 384비트 GDDR6 메모리 버스와 32GB 모델과 같은 70 CU RDNA 3 GPU를 갖췄습니다.

description.en: AMD workstation graphics card in the Radeon AI PRO R9000 series, built on RDNA 4 with 32 GB of GDDR6 memory and an actively cooled blower design aimed at local AI work.
description.ko: RDNA 4 기반의 AMD 라데온 AI PRO R9000 시리즈 워크스테이션 그래픽카드로, 32GB GDDR6 메모리와 블로워 방식 액티브 쿨링을 갖춰 로컬 AI 작업을 겨냥합니다.

facts.note: Start of sales in SI-built workstations per AMD's blog; standalone cards from board partners followed later in Q3 2025 (announced 2025-05-20 at COMPUTEX).

description.en: Passively cooled variant of AMD's Radeon AI PRO R9700, listed with the same 64-compute-unit RDNA 4 GPU and 32 GB of GDDR6 memory.
description.ko: AMD 라데온 AI PRO R9700의 패시브 쿨링 버전으로, 동일한 64 CU RDNA 4 GPU와 32GB GDDR6 메모리로 표기됩니다.

description.en: Passively cooled AMD Radeon AI PRO R9000 series card with a 48-compute-unit RDNA 4 GPU, 32 GB of GDDR6 memory and a 150 W board power rating.
description.ko: 48 CU RDNA 4 GPU와 32GB GDDR6 메모리, 150W 보드 전력 사양을 갖춘 패시브 쿨링 방식의 AMD 라데온 AI PRO R9000 시리즈 카드입니다.
